# XGBoost on the validation period (generated by `scripts/run_xgboost.py`)

Dataset sha256 `ee5bc65756cd7976...`, git commit `fb5f82121f` (working tree dirty: False); xgboost 3.4.1; 4 threads on 4 logical CPUs, CPU only. Validation targets 2024-01-01 to 2024-06-30; the test period was not loaded. Scenario A (no future weather) unless labelled oracle. Early stopping and the hyper-parameter search both use the validation period, so these validation numbers are mildly optimistic; the honest estimate is the one-time test evaluation. STAGE 2 (wide ranges, 60 trials, stage-1 best competes; trial -1 = stage-1 best). The ratio target is trained as 100*(ratio-1), i.e. percent deviation from the 24 h anchor.

## Horizon 1 h (train samples 19,887; validation samples 4,367)

Tuning: 60 random trials in 17.5 min; best trial #-1; params learning_rate=0.04259, max_depth=3, min_child_weight=2.024, subsample=0.6528, colsample_bytree=0.9921, reg_lambda=11.62, reg_alpha=0.008661, gamma=2.453

| feature set | #features | MAE ratio-target (MW, mean of 3 seeds +- sd) | MAE absolute-target (MW) |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| S0_history | 14 | 1,111 +- 4 | 1,568 +- 13 |
| S1_calendar | 20 | 1,076 +- 3 | 1,631 +- 14 |
| S2_holidays | 26 | 1,079 +- 4 | 1,661 +- 28 |
| S3_weatherA | 45 | 1,104 +- 5 | 1,754 +- 15 |
| S4_full_A | 51 | 1,112 +- 6 | 1,793 +- 11 |
| S5_oracle_B (oracle weather at t+h) | 63 | 1,110 +- 5 | 1,828 +- 5 |

Headline (S4_full_A, ratio target, mean of 3 seeds): MAE 1,104 MW, RMSE 1,692 MW, MAPE 0.56%, WAPE 0.56%, R2 0.993.
Best naive baseline MAE 4,430 MW; best ridge (ridge_full_abs) 1,089 MW. Paired MAE difference XGBoost minus best ridge: +15 MW (95% block-bootstrap CI -14 to +44; negative = XGBoost better).
MAE by season of the target hour: winter: 1,004 MW; pre_monsoon_summer: 1,133 MW; monsoon: 1,216 MW
Peak hours (target >= training 95th percentile, 205 GW, n=1635): MAE 1,264 MW.
